headline: Bitcoin Rebounds Above $61,000 but Closes November With Steep Losses
summary: Bitcoin rebounded past $61,000 alongside other digital assets amid broader global equity rallies, though it wrapped up November with its worst monthly drop in four years.
why: Cryptocurrency market valuations reflect speculative capital flows, macroeconomic liquidity conditions, and risk sentiment across digital assets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin spot prices rebounded above the $61,000 threshold.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A recovery in technology stocks and easing fears over artificial intelligence market bubbles improved risk appetite across crypto markets.
